name: Mashvisor
shortDescription: Rental comps and property analysis. Lite is $49.99 per month, billed annually.
longDescription: Mashvisor analyzes traditional and short-term rental comps. On October 16, 2026 the investor pricing page listed Lite at $49.99 per month billed annually, Standard at $74.99, and Professional at $99.99. We did not subscribe.
pricingNotes: Lite is $49.99 per month billed annually. Standard is $74.99. Professional is $99.99.
bestFor: Comparing rental income estimates on individual properties
notIdealFor: Someone researching raw land with no rental comps
strength: The investor pricing page lists Lite at $49.99 per month, billed annually, for rental comps.
weakness: The pricing page we checked does not show a $0 plan, and raw land is outside the rental-comps job.

useCaseFit.find-land: Compares rental comps on a property, and Lite is $49.99 per month billed annually.
